actions.name: create_candidate
actions.description: Creates a new candidate profile in Greenhouse.

actions.name: create_candidate_note
actions.description: Adds a note to an existing candidate profile in Greenhouse.

actions.name: create_prospect
actions.description: Creates a new prospect in Greenhouse — a person who has not yet applied to a specific job.

actions.name: update_candidate
actions.description: Updates an existing candidate profile in Greenhouse. Only fields you provide will be changed.

actions.name: find_candidate
actions.description: Searches for a candidate in Greenhouse by email address. Returns the first match.

actions.name: find_or_create_candidate
actions.description: Searches for a candidate by email address. If no match is found, creates a new candidate profile instead.

actions.name: find_due_scorecard
actions.description: Retrieves the full details of a scorecard by its ID. Use with the New Scorecard Due trigger to look up the scorecard that fired the flow.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_candidate_application
triggers.description: Triggers when a new application is submitted by a candidate.

triggers.name: candidate_hired
triggers.description: Triggers when a candidate is hired.

triggers.name: new_job_post
triggers.description: Triggers when a new job post is created.

triggers.name: job_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing job is updated.

triggers.name: new_scheduled_interview
triggers.description: Triggers when a new scheduled interview is created within the configured time window.

triggers.name: new_scorecard_due
triggers.description: Triggers when a new scorecard is due — i.e. created but not yet submitted by the interviewer.

guides.title: How to Automate Warm Intros Across Your Network
guides.excerpt: Warm intros become scalable when you integrate CRM data with communication platforms to trigger timely outreach.
